responsibility: This file implements GCC's basic concrete `diagnostic_path` representation used by diagnostics that want to record a realized sequence of events. It defines vector-backed event and thread objects, formats and stores event descriptions with optional localization, tracks stack depth, logical locations derived from `tree` function declarations, and same-function/connectivity properties, and under checking builds includes selftests for simple intraprocedural paths. It is the standard eager path container that lazy or test-specific path implementations build on or mimic.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable implementation of the simple-diagnostic-path classes declared in simple-diagnostic-path.h, including event/thread/path method bodies, event text formatting, path mutation logic, and file-local selftests.
